name: Welcome Back Nights
summary: Two evenings at the start of the year when parents meet their child's teachers and hear how the year will run: lessons, homework and how teachers keep families updated.

name: Mid-Autumn Festival
summary: An afternoon festival for families, with a show and a fair run by students.
did: Every class performed a song, dance or play, and the youngest children walked in a costume parade
Two students hosted the show, one in English and one in Vietnamese
Older students planned their own booths: they made the posters, set the prices and ran henna, bracelet, portrait drawing and game stalls

name: Halloween
summary: Two weeks of Halloween activities, ending with a costume day on 31 October.
did: Each class built a giant spider from an old umbrella and recycled materials
Students paraded in costume for their families
Older students ran activity rooms for the younger classes: a shadow puppet show, a marshmallow challenge and autumn games

name: Christmas Talent Show and Market
summary: An evening talent show and Christmas market for families. The money raised went to flood relief kits for families in Đà Nẵng.
did: Classes sang and danced, and students signed up for their own acts: piano, gymnastics, a Rubik's Cube act and a comedy skit
Two students hosted the show in English and Vietnamese
Students made and sold cookies, hot chocolate and fruit skewers, plus kimonos and stockings from their textiles class

name: March Mathness
when: March, with a family afternoon on 2 April
summary: A month of maths games across the whole campus.
did: Classes guessed where 15 metres ends, marked it in chalk, then checked with a tape measure
Students estimated the pom-poms in a jar, and winners took home prize stickers
At a Stay and Play afternoon, families joined their children at the game tables: mazes, cube towers, card puzzles and strategy games

name: Reading Safari Week
summary: A week of reading and storytelling.
did: Students wrote stories from dice rolls and mystery objects pulled from a bag
They designed new book covers in art class and voted for the best one
Everyone stopped to read at lunch, and the week ended with a costume parade and a campus festival of word games

name: Learning Without Walls
when: The last two weeks of the year
summary: For the last two weeks of the year, learning moved off campus.
did: Trips to the Kim Bồng carpentry village, a peanut butter workshop and a 3D art museum in Đà Nẵng
Volunteering at an elderly home in Đà Nẵng
A beach day, a sports day with a pool party, and an overnight camping trip for Year 6

name: Graduation
summary: Two ceremonies for families: one for Early Years and the younger Primary classes, one for the older students.
did: Every class performed: songs, a dance, speeches and a periodic table song
Each student walked up to receive a certificate
